get.description:
State of the latest backup, computed on every call from the files present (never from the
database, never a path or a file name): a client writes only if it is recent and verified.

post.description: Undo an edit: fields, variants, derived values and lock, or 409 `revert_conflict`.

get.description:
The writable fields per type (dotted names, byte order) and their bounds, so a
client can detect contract drift before writing.
Items to complete, e.g. those with no external id at all.

patch.description:
Partial write on EVERY variant, one transaction. Requires `If-Match` and
`Idempotency-Key`.

post.description:
Lock / unlock every variant (journaled). Unlocking gives the row back to the
automatic enrichment.
Simulate `PATCH`: same plan, nothing written (no journal row, no lock).

get.description: Find every item carrying EXACTLY ONE external id (or a unification id).
